functions.name: GE.ASK
functions.description: Streams a grounded Gemini Enterprise answer into the cell, grounded on the given range's values. Runs as the signed-in user.

parameters.name: prompt
parameters.description: What to ask about the range, e.g. "which region grew fastest?"

parameters.name: values
parameters.description: The range to ground on; its values are sent as data only.
